name: set_earth_tides
description: Turn the combined Sun-and-Moon water illustration on or off. Enabling focuses Earth in the current Explore or Orrery view. Unavailable in Sky or during mission replay; request a supported view first. No source, phase, pause, arrows, or recording controls. Water shape is exaggerated, not a coastal forecast.

enabled.description: True to show the water envelope around Earth; false to hide it.
